content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) has established an Insulin Access and Affordability Working Group to address the critical issue of insulin pricing. This group has conducted a comprehensive analysis of the insulin supply chain to identify the factors contributing to the high cost of insulin. Their investigation involved gathering insights and perspectives from various stakeholders involved in the supply chain. Based on this analysis, the ADA has developed and published specific recommendations aimed at improving the affordability of insulin, which are outlined in a dedicated statement released by the organization.
